_schema.description: Seed data for the Curbitas outreach tracker. This is a human-in-the-loop CRM: it organizes WHERE and HOW to promote curbitas.com in Brooklyn/Manhattan communities. It does NOT auto-post anywhere. You review every draft and post/send it yourself through each channel's legitimate path, respecting that community's rules. Copy this file to targets.json and edit freely; the tracker page reads targets.json if present, otherwise this sample.
_schema.why_manual: Facebook, Reddit, Nextdoor and Craigslist all detect and ban automated posting, and Buy Nothing groups forbid promotion outright. The durable strategy is organized, personalized, rule-respecting outreach done by a real person. This tool removes the tedium (finding targets, remembering rules, drafting copy, tracking follow-ups) while keeping you in control of what actually gets posted.

target_fields.name: Display name of the community, newsletter, forum, or organization.
target_fields.type: One of: buy_nothing, facebook_group, reddit, nextdoor, newsletter, forum, org, blog, event_board.
target_fields.audience: Rough size or reach if known (string, e.g. '12k members').
target_fields.promo_policy: allowed | mods_approve | submit_form | no_promo | unknown. Governs how (or whether) you may promote.
target_fields.approach: The compliant way in: e.g. 'submit via newsletter form', 'DM a mod first', 'participate then mention', 'never link, be a helpful member'.
target_fields.template: Which template key in templates.md fits this target.
target_fields.fit_notes: Why curbitas is relevant here / how to frame it.
target_fields.status: not_started | researching | contacted | posted | live | declined | do_not_contact. Live status is tracked per-target in the browser (localStorage) and can be exported.
target_fields.last_touch: Optional ISO date of your last action.

legend_promo_policy.mods_approve: Allowed only with moderator permission first — always ask.
legend_promo_policy.submit_form: Has an official submission/tip form — the correct, invited channel.
legend_promo_policy.no_promo: No promotion permitted. Participate as a genuine member only; never post your link. Value comes from goodwill, not a post.
legend_promo_policy.unknown: Read the rules before doing anything.

targets.name: The Skint
targets.approach: Use their tip/submit contact — a curb-finds tool is squarely on-brand for a free/cheap NYC list.
targets.fit_notes: Curbitas = free stuff on the curb. Perfect thematic match for a free-things newsletter.

targets.name: Brokelyn
targets.approach: Pitch as a story/tool tip: 'living well in BK for free'.
targets.fit_notes: Editorial angle: how curbitas helps you furnish an apartment off the curb.

targets.name: r/Brooklyn
targets.approach: Read rules; most NYC subs restrict self-promo. Message mods, or share only inside relevant threads as a helpful reply, not a standalone ad.
targets.fit_notes: Curb-alert and 'is this couch still there' posts are common; contribute value there.

targets.name: r/AskNYC
targets.approach: No self-promo. Answer 'where do I find free furniture' questions genuinely; mention the tool only if it truly answers the asker.
targets.fit_notes: High-intent questions about free/secondhand stuff appear weekly.

targets.name: Nextdoor — Brooklyn neighborhoods
targets.approach: Post from a real verified neighbor account in the 'Free items' / recommendations context; check each neighborhood's rules. Never mass-post across neighborhoods.
targets.fit_notes: Nextdoor's free-item culture overlaps directly with curbitas.

targets.name: Buy Nothing Park Slope
targets.approach: DO NOT post promo. Buy Nothing bans business/links. Join, gift and receive as a genuine member; if the tool ever comes up organically or an admin asks, mention it — otherwise build goodwill only.
targets.fit_notes: Aligned in spirit, but promotion here damages reputation. Presence > posting.
targets.next_step: Only engage authentically. No link drops.

targets.name: Buy Nothing Williamsburg / Greenpoint
targets.approach: Same as all Buy Nothing groups: participate authentically, never advertise.
targets.fit_notes: Reputation risk if spammed. Consider partnering with an admin instead of posting.

targets.name: Stooping NYC (@stoopingnyc)
targets.approach: This is the biggest curb-finds account in NYC — a potential PARTNER, not a place to spam. DM proposing a collab / shoutout / cross-post.
targets.fit_notes: Direct audience overlap. Partnership beats promotion.

targets.name: Buy Nothing — Manhattan (LES / UWS / Harlem)
targets.approach: Authentic participation only across Manhattan neighborhood groups.

targets.name: Gothamist / community tips
targets.approach: Send a tip pitching a story about NYC's stooping/curb-find culture featuring curbitas.
targets.fit_notes: Human-interest angle on reuse/sustainability in NYC.
